meta_description: 50 Shades Paint & Decor in Manchester. Expert interior and exterior painting, decorating, and finishes. Free quotes, professional results.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting. Meticulous prep, premium finishes, no mess left behind.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From feature walls and interior redecoration to full exterior repaints and specialist finishes, we handle every project with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Complete room refreshes with careful preparation, premium paints, and flawless finishes. We move furniture, protect floors, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work including fascias, soffits, and woodwork. We use quality exterior products built to last Manchester's climate.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging and feature wall creation. We source quality materials and ensure perfectly straight, bubble-free results every time.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, window frames, and fitted furniture painted to showroom finish. Meticulous sanding and priming for a professional look.

services.title: Commercial Repainting
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and commercial properties redecorated efficiently. We minimise disruption and work to your schedule.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Effects
services.desc: Textured finishes, paint effects, and bespoke colour matching. Transform ordinary walls into statement features that reflect your style.

about_pullquote: We do the job right so you never need a cowboy decorator twice.
about_para_1: 50 Shades Paint & Decor was founded on a simple idea: skilled painters shouldn't be hard to find in Manchester. After years of seeing botched jobs and unreliable tradespeople, we decided to set a different standard. We've been trading for over 8 years, completing hundreds of domestic and commercial projects across Denton, Ashton-under-Lyne, and the wider Manchester area.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on meticulous preparation, quality materials, and genuine care for your home. We turn up on time, do the job properly, and leave you delighted. The majority of our work comes from repeat customers and personal recommendations — that's the trust we've earned, one room at a time.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the entire downstairs done — living room, hallway, and kitchen. The lads were incredibly tidy, prepped everything properly, and the finish is brilliant. Fair price too. Would absolutely have them back.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Needed my exterior woodwork done before winter. They came out, gave me a realistic quote, and got the work finished in two days. No faffing about, just professional painters who know what they're doing. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michelle T.

reviews.text: Our office needed redecorating and we were worried about downtime. They worked around our hours, got the job done bang on schedule, and didn't leave a speck of mess. Really impressed. Using them again next year.
reviews.author: James L.
